lines.speaker: filch
lines.sound: Filch muttering to Mrs Norris as he shuffles past, never turning
text: Nothing here, my sweet. Nothing here.
Mud all down my clean corridor. Someone'll be sorry, my sweet.
Peeves again, I'll be bound. We'll have him out one day, my sweet.
My knees, my sweet. Up and down these stairs all day, and who thanks me?
lines.canon: ours, in his voice (the Corridor's req 454; the Ministry's corridor list, New work: "Nothing here, my sweet. Nothing here."); Filch's "my sweet" to Mrs Norris and his wish to have Peeves out, CoS 8 L9091, checked against the text, 15 October 2026; "Sniff around, my sweet" (PS 9 L3237) never used, since it is Harry's night; comic, he never sees him (the world rules)
